mechanics.name: Apocalyptic Ingenuity
mechanics.currentEffect: You see the Auras of broken Pallets within 24/28/32 metres. After rummaging through or unlocking a Chest, hold the Active Ability button beside a broken Pallet for 3 seconds to rebuild it as a Fragile Pallet, which breaks immediately when dropped.
activation: Rummage through or unlock a Chest.
Stand beside a broken Pallet and hold the Active Ability button for 3 seconds.
Ends/deactivates when: Fragile Pallet breaks immediately when dropped.
Ends/deactivates when: Rebuild interaction ends if interrupted.
mechanics.patchNote: Latest live balance change (10.1.0): Changed the prerequisite to one Chest interaction and reduced rebuild interaction to 3 seconds.
mechanics.plainEnglishSummary: After a Chest interaction, you can rebuild one broken Pallet as a Fragile Pallet.
mechanics.oncePerTrialOrOtherLimits: One Chest interaction enables one rebuild; another qualifying interaction is needed for another rebuild.
specialInteractions: The rebuilt Fragile Pallet breaks immediately when dropped.

editorial.summary: After interacting with a chest, rebuild one broken pallet as a Fragile Pallet; the reconstructed pallet breaks immediately when dropped.
useCases: Restore a pallet body at a previously exhausted tile.
Use broken-pallet Aura information to identify possible rebuild locations.
Create a temporary resource the Killer must still account for during pathing.
counters: Requires a chest unlock or rummage first.
The Fragile Pallet breaks immediately when dropped.
Only one rebuilt pallet can be created from the perk's setup.
pros: Can restore interaction geometry to an exhausted tile.
cons: Often inferior to rotating to an untouched tile.
analysis: Apocalyptic Ingenuity ranks this position because rebuilding a pallet sounds stronger than the actual Fragile Pallet mechanic. The reconstructed resource breaks immediately when dropped, so the Survivor is not recreating a full normal pallet loop.

The effect can still matter. Restoring the pallet body changes pathing, creates a possible stun interaction, and may force the Killer to respect a resource at a tile they thought was completely exhausted.
The chest setup is the bigger issue. A Survivor must spend time unlocking or rummaging before the rebuild is available, adding a side objective before a situational chase payoff.
That keeps the perk near the bottom of the global list. It is mechanically unique and occasionally clever, but normal rotation to an existing tile is usually cheaper than manufacturing a fragile one.
editorial.verdict: A creative way to resurrect a dead tile, with emphasis on 'fragile.' Apocalyptic Ingenuity creates options, not a full pallet refund.
